draft.heroMessage: Matching People With Homes Across Generations
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I'm proud to offer trusted, personalized real estate guidance rooted in decades of local expertise in Roanoke and the surrounding areas.
draft.tagline: Trusted Guidance for Buyers, Sellers, Investors, and Growing Families Across the Roanoke Valley.
draft.aboutParagraph: As a lifelong Roanoke resident and founder of Rocky's Mom Realty, my focus is on relationships that span generations. Since 2006, individuals and families have relied on my unique blend of deep local market knowledge, property management experience, and honest communication. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, investor, or planning your next chapter, I bring clarity, confidence, and a client-first approach to every stage of your journey. My commitment is to serve you with detailed support tailored to your goals and timeline—because in real estate, relationships matter most.
draft.conciergeLine: Have questions or want to discuss your next move? Contact me for thoughtful advice and local insight.
draft.contactLine: Call (540) 400-5980 or email rockysmomllc@gmail.com for a personal consultation.
draft.tone: Warm, relationship-focused, and local. Emphasizes trust, community ties, and personal guidance.
